Important Note: 
1. Classes will be scheduled for 06 days working (Monday to Saturday), and a regular 
course has engagement of 08 lectures for Fractal-1 and 09 lectures for Fractal 2 & 3 
(one lecture of 75 minutes). 
2. If the requisite number of lectures cannot be scheduled, the instructors may, in 
consultation with the students in their respective courses, decide on a schedule of 
extra classes. 
3. Saturdays and Sundays falling within the examination period will be used for 
scheduling examinations. Under extraordinary circumstances, examinations of some 
of the courses may be scheduled on the days preceding the Minor/Major examinations.
